snapshot.title: Active upload or privileged preview may execute untrusted content
snapshot.description: Investigates uploaded or imported active content that may execute in storefront, embedded admin, customer-account, or operator preview surfaces.

reason.message: No [app_proxy] section in shopify.app.toml or shopify.app.dev.toml, no appProxy/logged_in_customer_id/application/liquid handling in app/, workers/ or extensions/ (extensions are a Validation Function and an admin_link).

snapshot.title: App proxy Liquid injection risk
snapshot.description: Detects app proxy endpoints that interpolate request parameters into active Liquid or HTML responses.

reason.message: No app proxy is configured in shopify.app.toml/shopify.app.dev.toml and no route reads proxy parameters (shop, logged_in_customer_id, path_prefix, signature).

snapshot.title: App proxy request trusted without signature verification
snapshot.description: Detects app proxy parameters read without visible signature verification.

snapshot.title: Committed secret or environment file
snapshot.description: Detects environment files and common API key/token patterns in source files.

snapshot.title: Credential reaches the client browser
snapshot.description: Detects direct credential flows into responses, loaders, globals, DOM, and external requests.

snapshot.title: Credential reaches a log sink
snapshot.description: Detects direct credential flows to console and logger sinks.

snapshot.title: Cross-site scripting risk
snapshot.description: Investigates lower-trust data rendered as executable browser content in app-owned pages.

snapshot.title: Cross-site request forgery protection may be missing
snapshot.description: Investigates state-changing endpoints for missing request authenticity protections.

snapshot.title: Vulnerable dependency may be reachable in app code
snapshot.description: Investigates whether a vulnerable dependency version is actually used through the affected API, helper, or configuration.

snapshot.title: Deprecated ScriptTag capability
snapshot.description: Detects the deprecated write_script_tags OAuth scope in shopify.app.toml.

snapshot.title: End-of-life API version
snapshot.description: Detects parsed config and React Router server API versions past the 12-month support window and 30-day grace period.

snapshot.title: Expiring offline access tokens explicitly disabled
snapshot.description: Verifies React Router expiring offline-token configuration and refresh-metadata storage compatibility.

snapshot.title: Configured callback URL is not HTTPS
snapshot.description: Detects webhook subscriptions and OAuth redirect URLs configured with unsafe absolute URLs.

reason.message: No theme app extension and no .liquid files: extensions/ contains only a function (cf-ready-validation) and an admin_link (support-link).

snapshot.title: Unsafe Liquid metafield or setting output
snapshot.description: Detects metafield and merchant-setting output without context-appropriate escaping or serialization.

snapshot.title: Metafield write in an unverified offline token context
snapshot.description: Investigates metafield and metaobject writes made with an offline Admin API context that no verified request for the same shop authorizes.

snapshot.title: Authorization check may be missing
snapshot.description: Investigates authenticated handlers that may not authorize access to the requested resource.

snapshot.title: Missing mandatory GDPR compliance webhooks
snapshot.description: Detects apps missing mandatory compliance webhooks (shop/redact, customers/data_request, customers/redact).

snapshot.title: Embedded app missing frame-ancestors CSP directive
snapshot.description: Detects embedded apps that set document response headers but omit frame-ancestors.

snapshot.title: Database query may not be scoped by shop
snapshot.description: Detects database queries in authenticated routes that don't reference the shop domain or session.

snapshot.title: Open redirect in auth callback
snapshot.description: Detects redirect targets taken from request parameters without validation.

snapshot.title: Data access may exceed the current request
snapshot.description: Investigates reads that may expose data outside the authenticated shop or user boundary.

snapshot.title: Request input selects Admin API shop context
snapshot.description: Detects request-derived shop values passed into unauthenticated.admin(...), allowing callers to select another shop's Admin API context.

snapshot.title: Query scoped by shop value taken from request input
snapshot.description: Detects queries whose shop scope comes from request params rather than the authenticated session. Presence of a shop key is not proof of scoping when its value is attacker-controlled.

snapshot.title: OAuth scope may be over-requested
snapshot.description: Detects declared OAuth scopes that don't appear to be used by the app code.

reason.message: No scriptTagCreate/scriptTagUpdate/ScriptTag REST usage anywhere in app/, workers/ or extensions/; declared scopes are write_validations plus optional write_translations, read_locales, read_markets (shopify.app.toml:51-52), with no write_script_tags.

snapshot.title: ScriptTag URL may be request controlled
snapshot.description: Investigates ScriptTag writes whose source URL may be controlled by untrusted input.

snapshot.title: Session lifecycle or replay control may be missing
snapshot.description: Investigates stale sessions, replayable signed links, and missing invalidation or idempotency across lifecycle transitions.

snapshot.title: SQL injection risk
snapshot.description: Investigates lower-trust input that changes SQL syntax in a reachable database operation.

snapshot.title: Server-side request forgery risk
snapshot.description: Investigates server-side requests whose destinations may be controlled by request input.

snapshot.title: Embedded app frame-ancestors uses a wildcard
snapshot.description: Detects wildcard or static cross-shop frame-ancestors policies in embedded app code, whether written literally or built from variables.

snapshot.title: Text setting may be rendered as unsafe HTML
snapshot.description: Investigates merchant-configurable text rendered as HTML without sanitization.

reason.message: extensions/ contains only cf-ready-validation (Cart and Checkout Validation Function) and support-link (admin_link); no *.liquid files or theme app extension assets exist in the repository.

snapshot.title: Theme extension cross-site scripting risk
snapshot.description: Investigates untrusted values rendered without safe escaping in theme extensions.

snapshot.title: Route handler lacks recognized auth verification
snapshot.description: Uses the template route-auth heuristic, with agent review for context.shopify.authenticate.admin calls instead of treating them as missing authentication.
